newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian president leaves for Britain, Italy.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian president leaves for Britain, Italy.

text.p: Tanzanian President Benjamin Mkapa left on Sunday for a 10-day visit to Britain and Italy, government officials said.
They said Mkapa would meet Britain's Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine, Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind and Overseas Development Minister Lynda Chalker.
The Tanzanian leader is likely to press for debt relief and balance of payment support to sustain the country's economic reform programme.
Mkapa, who is accompanied by his wife Anna, was also expected to have an audience with Queen Elizabeth.
On Tuesday Mkapa is due to fly to Rome to attend the World Food Summit before returning to Tanzania on November 19.
